## Rancher Government Solutions - Senior Software Engineer

🔗 [Apply](https://workforcenow.adp.com/mascsr/default/mdf/recruitment/recruitment.html?cid=6b57ff97-b4e8-4dd6-86db-e2294344fdba&ccId=19000101_000001&jobId=594959)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior Software Engineer building secure Go and Kubernetes systems for Rancher Government Solutions. Developing cloud-native infrastructure for U.S. federal agencies and regulated environments.
Senior Software Engineer building Go and Kubernetes solutions for U.S. federal agencies at Rancher Government Solutions
- Tech stack: AWS, Azure, Cloud, JavaScript, Kubernetes, Linux, Microservices, Nuxt, Vue.js, Go
- Develop robust Golang applications and microservices using Kubernetes design patterns such as controllers, operators, and custom resource definitions
- Understand CI/CD flows and pipelines to automate application testing, packaging, and deployment to Kubernetes clusters in secure environments
- Participate in daily standups, sprint planning, and retrospectives as part of an agile, iterative team
- Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code and GitOps solutions using Helm and Kustomize
- Collaborate with product managers, security teams, and engineers to deliver software meeting federal compliance standards such as FedRAMP and NIST 800-53
- Troubleshoot complex issues across application performance, networking, and container orchestration
- Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers
- Perform other duties as assigned
- 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 4 years working with Go
- Highly proficient in Golang, with demonstrated ability to write clean, maintainable, and idiomatic code
- Deep understanding of Kubernetes deployment and development patterns, including manifests, controllers, Helm charts, and RBAC
- Deep familiarity with containerization technologies, processes, and patterns
- Experience working in Linux-based environments
- Strong grasp of Git-based workflows and version control best practices
- US Citizenship
- Preferred: experience implementing secure software development practices in regulated environments

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Software Engineer building secure Go and Kubernetes systems for Rancher Government Solutions. Developing cloud-native infrastructure for U.S. federal agencies and regulated environments.
Senior Software Engineer building Go and Kubernetes solutions for U.S. federal agencies at Rancher Government Solutions
Role description:
• Develop robust Golang applications and microservices using Kubernetes design patterns such as controllers, operators, and custom resource definitions
• Understand CI/CD flows and pipelines to automate application testing, packaging, and deployment to Kubernetes clusters in secure environments
• Participate in daily standups, sprint planning, and retrospectives as part of an agile, iterative team
• Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code and GitOps solutions using Helm and Kustomize
• Collaborate with product managers, security teams, and engineers to deliver software meeting federal compliance standards such as FedRAMP and NIST 800-53
• Troubleshoot complex issues across application performance, networking, and container orchestration
• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers
• Perform other duties as assigned
Role requirements:
• 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 4 years working with Go
• Highly proficient in Golang, with demonstrated ability to write clean, maintainable, and idiomatic code
• Deep understanding of Kubernetes deployment and development patterns, including manifests, controllers, Helm charts, and RBAC
• Deep familiarity with containerization technologies, processes, and patterns
• Experience working in Linux-based environments
• Strong grasp of Git-based workflows and version control best practices
• US Citizenship
• Preferred: experience implementing secure software development practices in regulated environments
• Preferred: familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, or other federal clouds
• Preferred: knowledge of networking concepts, including ingress controllers, service meshes such as Istio, and load balancing
• Preferred: experience developing user interfaces with Vue.js, NuxtJS, or other Javascript frameworks
Benefits:
• No benefits or compensation extras specified
Tech stack:
AWS, Azure, Cloud, JavaScript, Kubernetes, Linux, Microservices, Nuxt, Vue.js, Go
